visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Fast Exponentiation by Squaring
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The loop multiplies exponent times. Rewrite power with exponentiation by squaring so it needs only about log2(exponent) steps. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Squaring the base each round and halving the exponent uses the binary digits of the exponent: when the lowest bit is 1 the current base is multiplied in. 2^10 needs 4 rounds instead of 10 multiplications.
